layout.description: Primary keyboard layout (e.g., 'us', 'de', 'fr', 'ru'). Use comma-separated values for multilingual setups (e.g., 'us,ru').

variant.description: Optional layout variant(s) corresponding to each layout (e.g., 'dvorak', 'nodeadkeys'). Leave empty if using default variant(s).

options.description: XKB options to customize behavior (e.g., switching layout with Alt+Shift, swapping Caps Lock and Ctrl). Leave empty for defaults.

model.description: Physical keyboard model. 'pc105' is standard for most PCs. Other common values include 'pc104', 'pc102', 'sun5'.

rules.description: XKB ruleset. 'base' works for most distributions; 'evdev' is used on some systems for better hardware support.

device.description: Optional input device path (e.g., '/dev/input/event0') to apply layout only to a specific keyboard. Leave blank to configure all keyboards system-wide.
